fact_types.title: Exception 1 component C1 (ADR-0050): whether the return's only capital gains are Form 1099-DIV box-2a capital-gain distributions. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession. Distinct from the checked schedule-d-required.conclusion.

Exception 1 component C2 (ADR-0050): whether the return has no capital losses. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession. Distinct from the checked schedule-d-required.conclusion.

Exception 1 component C3 (ADR-0050): whether no capital gain is being deferred through a qualified opportunity fund. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession. Distinct from the checked schedule-d-required.conclusion.

Exception 1 component C4 (ADR-0050): whether no Form 1099-DIV or substitute statement has an amount in box 2b, 2c, or 2d. Return-level contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession. Not a source-family claim and creates no member, family, closure, mapping, or collection path for boxes 2b/2c/2d. Distinct from box-2a family closure and from the checked schedule-d-required.conclusion.

Checked Schedule-D-required conclusion for the direct line-7a route (ADR-0050 Decision 1): domain {yes, no}. Published only from the accepted binding over C1-C4 (all present and yes -> no; all present and any no -> yes; any missing -> unpublished blocked DEPENDENCY_ABSENT naming every missing component).
